app.name: WiiKart
app.long_description: Race cars defined by real-world specs (horsepower, stopping distance, lateral grip) over three circuits, including stylized versions of Colorado's Berthoud Pass and Loveland Pass with real grades and gravity. 3 laps against AI, up to 4-player split screen, items, drifting, procedural engine audio. Supports Wii Remote (tilt), Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pads and USB keyboards. Runs on the Wii via the Homebrew Channel and in the Dolphin emulator.
